fields.name: work_memory_low
fields.meaning: Game working memory, not part of the save; changes during normal play
fields.evidence: diff: changes on almost every step s1..s129; code: save writer d000:905b never copies from it

fields.name: live_party_block
fields.meaning: Live party/unit data the game plays with; copied into the save record on saving, copied back on loading (same layout as rows at 0x111E)
fields.evidence: code d000:90b8 (copy into slot), d000:911a (copy back on load)

fields.name: slot0_marker_B
fields.meaning: Start marker 'B' (0x42); cleared to 0 before writing and set last, so a cut-off save is detected
fields.evidence: code d000:9089/90d7 (write), d000:917f (check); value in s66/s109/s129

fields.name: slot0_world_block
fields.meaning: Saved map and event state: copy of work memory 0x3980-0x3DA3 (rows below)
fields.evidence: code d000:90a2 copies 0x424 bytes from 0x3980; d000:9106 copies back

fields.name: obj_x
fields.meaning: Pixel X of each of 16 map characters (entry 0 = player)
fields.evidence: diff s66->s109: [0] 0x158->0x148 (1 tile left); s109->s129: 0x148->0x118 (3 tiles left); X/16 == tile column

fields.name: obj_y
fields.meaning: Pixel Y of each of 16 map characters
fields.evidence: value: Y/16 == tile row (entry 2 follows obj_y2: 0xD6->0x0D); unchanged by horizontal test moves

fields.name: obj_x2
fields.meaning: Second X per character (movement target/shadow; entry 0 is what the map-draw path reads with the facing)
fields.evidence: code f000:8782 reads entry 0; diff: moves together with obj_x in all three saves

fields.name: obj_y2
fields.meaning: Second Y per character (mid-move snapshot; entries 1,2 differ from obj_y)
fields.evidence: code f000:8786 reads entry 0

fields.name: obj_flags
fields.meaning: Per-character flag word (values 2/3/7 seen)
fields.evidence: code f000:8b02 (clear all), f000:8b1e (set bit 1), f000:8b3a (clear bit 1) via event commands

fields.name: obj_sprite
fields.meaning: Per-character appearance/sprite id (0x3C player, 0x53/0x4A/0x86...; 0 in unused slots 13/14)
fields.evidence: value shape (varied per character, zero when unused); no reader in fixed code banks

fields.name: obj_tile_x
fields.meaning: Tile column of each character (== pixel X / 16)
fields.evidence: diff s66->s109: [0] 0x15->0x14; s109->s129: 0x14->0x11, tracking obj_x in both moves

fields.name: obj_tile_y
fields.meaning: Tile row of each character (== pixel Y / 16, following obj_y2)
fields.evidence: value: [0] = 4 with pixel Y 0x48

fields.name: obj_aux
fields.meaning: Per-character table, 0xFF where unused with two 4-zero gaps
fields.evidence: value only

fields.name: unknown_c
fields.meaning: Mixed table: repeated pointer-ish words (0x3394 x2), small words (0x25/0x26 pattern)
fields.evidence: value only; no absolute refs in fixed code banks

fields.name: zero_pad
fields.meaning: All zero in every save seen
fields.evidence: diff s66/s109/s129

fields.name: obj_facing
fields.meaning: Facing of each character (d-pad bit 1/2/4/8 -> facing 1/0/2/3; entry 0 = player; entry 15 = 6, special slot)
fields.evidence: code f000:87e4 (player, from d-pad at ctx+0x356), f000:8a45 (any char); diff 1->3->2 across s66/s109/s129 matching d-pad bits

fields.name: obj_attr
fields.meaning: Per-character attribute set by event commands
fields.evidence: code f000:8a6c writes it

fields.name: unknown_d
fields.meaning: Unknown bytes (0C 2E 00 00 00 04 00 in s109)
fields.evidence: value only

fields.name: leader_unit
fields.meaning: Unit number of the party leader on the map (index into unit records; 6 = Musha Gundam)
fields.evidence: code f000:874a indexes unit table (n-1)*0x42 from 0x6C8 by it; value 6 matches unit record 6 (LV 8, HP 50, EX 64 = status screen s83)

fields.name: event_state
fields.meaning: Event/script progress: fields plus twelve 4-byte ROM script/data addresses (0x13AFF1, 0x13B255, 0x235125, 0x2351E7, 0x235247, 0x2351C5, 0x2351F8, 0x23B514, 0x2352E6, 0x13B2AB, 0x235142, 0x13B2AB)
fields.evidence: ROM probes: addresses point at script-ish data; 0x0A1874 holds a table containing 0x13AFF1/0x13B255; code d000:9d99..9e0d writes byte at +0x108

fields.name: event_cmd_result
fields.meaning: Event-command result byte (work 0x3CD0; values 0/1/2 written by cmd logic, 4 in s109)
fields.evidence: code d000:9d99/9dae/9dbe/9dd3/9ddf/9e06/9e0d, d000:a117/a14f, d000:d872 write 0x3CD0

fields.name: event_last_dpad
fields.meaning: Last-move raw d-pad bit (1/8/4 across s66/s109/s129)
fields.evidence: diff across three saves: values match exactly the d-pad inputs implied by the facing changes (f000:87e4 map); also changes on every movement step in the tree

fields.name: battle_work
fields.meaning: Battle/party bookkeeping, nearly all zero in saves: word at +0 (work 0x3D08) = battle counter, party-list copy at +9 (work 0x3D11), byte 0x0A at +0x1A (work 0x3D22)
fields.evidence: code: 0x3D08 incremented at d000:c868/c8fc/caa2/cb06/cb6e + d000:d661, preset 0x4A/0x8F/0x99/0x9F; 0x3D11[bx] written d000:d647/d656, read d000:d76a; 0x3D0C/0x3D0E read by battle code

fields.name: world_tail11
fields.meaning: Last 11 bytes of the world block (00 7B 00 FF FF FF 00 00 00 7B 00)
fields.evidence: value only; no absolute refs in fixed code banks (first-pass link to d000:9d85..9df6 corrected: that code writes 0x3CD0 = 0x1049, not here)

fields.name: slot0_marker_E
fields.meaning: Middle marker 'E' (0x45)
fields.evidence: code d000:908e/90d2 (write), d000:9178 (check)

fields.name: slot0_party_block
fields.meaning: Saved party and unit data: copy of work 0x06A0-0x0CF7 (rows below)
fields.evidence: code d000:90b8 copies 0x658 bytes from 0x6A0; d000:911a copies back

fields.name: party_count
fields.meaning: Number of units in the party (2 in s109)
fields.evidence: value: 2 followed by two unit numbers then 0xFF

fields.name: party_members
fields.meaning: Unit numbers in party order, 0xFF = empty (6, 7 in s109)
fields.evidence: code d000:b3cd (status screen indexes by it), d000:d643 (copies 11), d000:d76a (reads 0x3D11 copy)

fields.name: hdr_pad1
fields.meaning: Zero padding (work 0x6AC-0x6B6)
fields.evidence: value: all zero

fields.name: counter_6b7
fields.meaning: Script-set counter word (0 in all saves; also copied to status display var 0x231F)
fields.evidence: code d000:a02f (event cmd stores word here), d000:a03a..a0c9 (compare/add logic), d000:b403+f000:310b (status screen -> 0x231F)

fields.name: hdr_pad2
fields.meaning: Zero padding (work 0x6B9-0x6BF)
fields.evidence: value: all zero

fields.name: val_6c0
fields.meaning: Unknown word, 0 in saves (written d000:9e25; read with val_6c2)

fields.name: val_6c2
fields.meaning: Unknown word, 1 in every save seen (only ever compared against 0)

fields.name: val_6c4
fields.meaning: Unknown word, 0 in saves (copied to work var 0x2FB4)
fields.evidence: code d000:8fba (write), f000:3e6e (read)

fields.name: val_6c6
fields.meaning: Unknown word, 0 in saves (low byte copied to 0x2F82)
fields.evidence: code d000:8fc2 (write), f000:3e79 (read)

fields.name: unit_records
fields.meaning: 11 unit records of 0x42 bytes; unit n (1-11) at 0x1146 + (n-1)*0x42 (field rows below = offsets inside a record)
fields.evidence: code d000:a1c5 (join: (n-1)*0x42 from 0x6C8), d000:b3c9 (status screen)

fields.name: inv_hdr
fields.meaning: Count + tiny table header, probably items/equipment list (01 01 08 00 = work 0x99E-0x9A1)
fields.evidence: code: 0x99E compared with 0/0x27 across menu/battle code (d000:9edf..c63e), 0x99F[bx]/0x9A0[bx] indexed reads

fields.name: gap_zero
fields.meaning: 752 zero bytes (work 0x9A2-0xC97); probably empty item/inventory storage or padding
fields.evidence: value: all zero in s66/s109/s129

fields.name: flags_a
fields.meaning: Bitflag bank A: 384 progress flags (work 0xC98-0xCC7), bit (id-1); s109 ids set: 12, 22, 131, 132, 145, 195, 219, 230
fields.evidence: code f000:bd45+ tests/sets bit ((id-1)/8 byte, 1<<((id-1)%8) mask) against base 0xC98

fields.name: flags_b
fields.meaning: Bitflag bank B: 384 flags (work 0xCC8-0xCF7), same content as bank A in every save (seen/confirmed pair or backup copy)
fields.evidence: code f000:bd61 same access against base 0xCC8; value: identical to bank A in s66/s109/s129

fields.name: slot0_marker_C
fields.meaning: End marker 'C' (0x43)
fields.evidence: code d000:9093/90cd (write), d000:9171 (check)

fields.name: slot0_checksum
fields.meaning: Checksum: 16-bit sum of bytes 0x0CF9-0x111C and 0x111E-0x1775 (markers excluded)
fields.evidence: code d000:90aa/90c0/90c9 (write), d000:9150/9162/916b (check); recomputed OK: s66 0xAD15, s109 0xACFD, s129 0xAC95, 60 tree saves + both copies

fields.name: slot1_copy
fields.meaning: Second copy of the whole record (same layout, +0xA81); written with identical content at each save
fields.evidence: code: record base = copy# x 0xA81 (d000:9082/90fd/913e); byte-identical in all post-save states; checksums recomputed

fields.name: work_memory_high
fields.meaning: Game working memory, includes live world block 0x3980-0x3DA3; not part of the save
fields.evidence: diff: changes on most steps

fields.name: system_eeprom
fields.meaning: Console owner data only; the game does not write it
fields.evidence: diff: boot.ieep identical to s109.ieep and s129.ieep
